folders.head: dc315771747c55954e1cac1f21c670a2843a49ce
folders.question: Can a reader follow input loading, fitting, prediction and scoring inside forecasts/? Give a verdict on the folder layout and explain which paths you would keep or move.
criteria: Trace actual files inside forecasts/ through the workflow.
Explain one concrete ownership decision and its consequence for a reader.

receipt.head: bf3754b6fe115bc85f9740c0dd1c531aedc9729a
receipt.question: Does retaining a response require separate S3 objects for bytes and a receipt? Compare the simplest credible designs and recommend one.
criteria: Trace a crash between writes, including what a later poll can reconstruct.
Compare with a single-object design against the requirement and explain the deciding tradeoff. Either recommendation can pass.

independent.head: bf3754b6fe115bc85f9740c0dd1c531aedc9729a
independent.question: Have two independent reviewers examine this change. Have one trace an interrupted archive write and the other compare the README with the storage implementation. Give me one decision incorporating their evidence.
criteria: The final decision accounts for evidence from both. Check the individual answers after blind grading.

clean.head: 6292e195c26325b9fcc7f8fce607fcb8ab9b7867
clean.question: Check whether StoredResponse can be imported from its model module without an S3 adapter dependency. Does this dependency direction need a change?
criteria: Verify the definition and imports at this revision.
Keep the dependency direction if it meets the requirement. Flag any invented need for a redesign.

parallel.head: dc315771747c55954e1cac1f21c670a2843a49ce
parallel.question: Two decisions are holding up this stack. Can a new reader trace training through the Python package? Separately, do the diagrams and links in the offline viewer explain the artifacts the runner emits? Trace both from their own entry points and give a verdict on each.
criteria: Independent inspection actually ran for at least one of the two substantial questions.
The final review gives a supported answer for both questions; verify that each citation addresses the relevant decision.
